Bulk.docs: Several events in one packet. `v` holds them in order. Unpack it and handle each one.

Error.docs: The gateway refused you. `data.type` is an error type. After `InvalidSession` or `MissingIntent` the connection closes.

Ready.docs: Your starting data. Events flow from here on. Fields you have no intent for are left out.

Pong.docs: The answer to your `Ping`, with the same `data`.

Message.docs: A new message. Without `MESSAGE_CONTENT` the text, embeds, files and components are removed, unless the bot wrote it, is mentioned, or it is a DM.

MessageUpdate.docs: A message changed: `data` has the new fields, `clear` the removed ones. Pins arrive here too.

MessageAppend.docs: The server added embeds to a message, for example a link preview.

MessageRemoveReaction.docs: All reactions of one emoji were removed.

BulkMessageDelete.docs: Several messages were deleted at once.

ServerCreate.docs: The bot joined a server: the whole server, its channels, emojis and voice states.

ServerUpdate.docs: A server changed: `data` has the new fields, `clear` the removed ones.

ServerDelete.docs: A server was deleted. Forget everything about it.

ServerMemberUpdate.docs: A member changed: nickname, roles, avatar or timeout. The bot always sees its own.

ServerMemberJoin.docs: A member joined. The bot always sees itself join.

ServerMemberLeave.docs: A member left, was kicked or banned: `reason` says which. When `user` is the bot, it left that server.

ServerRoleUpdate.docs: A role was created or changed.

ServerRoleRanksUpdate.docs: The order of the roles changed. `ranks` lists role ids from the highest down.

UserUpdate.docs: A user changed their profile. Without `PRESENCE` status changes are left out.

UserPlatformWipe.docs: An account was removed from Zrzur. Delete what you store about that user.

ChannelCreate.docs: A channel was created, or a DM with the bot was opened. DMs arrive without `SERVERS` too.

ChannelUpdate.docs: A channel changed: `data` has the new fields, `clear` the removed ones.

ChannelGroupJoin.docs: Someone joined a group. Bots are in groups only when a person added them.

WebhookUpdate.docs: A webhook changed: `data` has the new fields, `remove` the removed ones.

UserVoiceStateUpdate.docs: Someone's voice state changed, for example muted or sharing a screen.

UserMoveVoiceChannel.docs: A moderator moved the bot: use `token` to connect to the new channel on `node`.

VoiceCallUpdate.docs: A call in a channel started or ended.

InteractionCreate.docs: Someone used a command, button, select, form or autocomplete of this bot. See Commands and interactions.

ApplicationCommandsUpdate.docs: An application changed its commands in this server. Clients use it to reload the list; a bot can ignore it.

clientMessages.Authenticate: Your first message. `token` is the bot token, `intents` the sum of the intents you want.
clientMessages.Ping: Keeps the line tested. `data` is a number of your choice and comes back in `Pong`.
clientMessages.BeginTyping: Shows the bot as typing in `channel`. Send it again every few seconds to keep it up.
clientMessages.Subscribe: Ask for presence and member updates of `server_id`. Bots need `SERVER_MEMBERS` or `PRESENCE` to see those updates.
